import numpy as np
n=6;i=np.arange(n);D=np.minimum(abs(i[:,None]-i[None,:]),n-abs(i[:,None]-i[None,:])).astype(float)
S=np.eye(n)+.18*np.exp(-D/1.7)
M=np.diag([1.02,.96,.90,1.05,.98,1.01])+.025*(D==1)+.007*(D==2)
K=np.diag([-.7,-.25,.1,.55,-.4,.35])-.16*(D==1)+.03*(D==2)
c=np.array([0,1,0,1,0,1]);sig=np.array([1.,-1.,-1.,1.,1.,-1.]);R=np.eye(2)[c]*sig[:,None]

def _pack_result(value):
    mu,rho,action=value
    return np.concatenate((np.array([mu,*rho.shape,*action.shape],dtype=float),rho.ravel(),action.ravel()))

def _finite_call(fun):
    with np.errstate(over="raise",invalid="raise",divide="raise",under="ignore"):
        result=fun()
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(result)):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite output")
    return result
assert np.allclose(_finite_call(lambda: _pack_result(solve_fixed_population_density(S,M,K,R,D,c,sig,24.0,2.25,1,1.0))), target)

import numpy as np
n=6;i=np.arange(n);D=np.minimum(abs(i[:,None]-i[None,:]),n-abs(i[:,None]-i[None,:])).astype(float)
S=np.eye(n)+.18*np.exp(-D/1.7)
M=np.diag([1.02,.96,.90,1.05,.98,1.01])+.025*(D==1)+.007*(D==2)
K=np.diag([-.7,-.25,.1,.55,-.4,.35])-.16*(D==1)+.03*(D==2)
c=np.array([0,1,0,1,0,1]);sig=np.array([1.,-1.,-1.,1.,1.,-1.]);R=np.eye(2)[c]*sig[:,None]
R=R/np.sqrt(3.)

def run_model():
    try:
        solve_fixed_population_density(S,M,K,R,D,c,sig,24.0,2.25,2,1.0)
        return 0
    except ValueError:
        return 1
    except Exception:
        return 2
assert np.allclose(run_model(), target)
